name: evey-plugin-lumina
comment: The front module has ZERO runtime dependencies: raw WebGL + vanilla DOM, bundled by esbuild. Only the nodejs backend stub (main.js) needs runtime deps, so only @grpc ships in node_modules. There is no network updater: every visual (veils, caustics, particles) is procedural, computed locally in the shader from the palette/intensity/speed settings, so the plugin ships with permission 'prefs' only.
